hooks.name: Validate steering file changes
hooks.description: Validates that changes to steering files are additive and consistent — new context extends rather than contradicts existing decisions, invariants, and implementation state. Ensures decisions-log entries follow the append-only format.

action.prompt:
A steering file was just saved. Check the following:
1. If decisions-log.md was modified, verify the new entry follows the DECISION-{number} format and has all required fields (Date, Context, Decision, Impact, Status). Warn if an existing decision was edited rather than appended.
2. If implementation-state.md was modified, verify tasks moved correctly between sections (Next Up → In Progress → Completed) and no completed tasks were removed.
3. If any other steering file was modified, check that it does not contradict the safety-invariants.md (the 12 hard invariants) or remove existing requirements from project-context.md.
4. Confirm the change is additive/non-breaking — new context should extend, not conflict with, existing implementation work.
If any issue is found, report it clearly. Otherwise confirm the steering update is consistent.
